name: Rorschach Bloom
desc: A crisp bilaterally-symmetric inkblot: hard-edged organic lobes, tendrils and satellite droplets threshold out of a fractal-noise field, pool dark at their wet bleeding rims, hold, then perpetually morph into a new blot — deep indigo/oxblood ink bleeding into off-white paper.

spread.doc: blot size / ink coverage (lower threshold = bigger blot)

warp.doc: tendril turbulence / edge raggedness (fractal warp of the boundary)

energy.doc: ink depth / wet-rim contrast / glow exposure

density.doc: lobe count & satellite-droplet richness (fine fractal detail)
